{{Quote|Working for Lt. Col. Quelsh is an honor that I would be hesitant to relinquish.|Edbr Yamagh, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />}}
'''Edbr Yamagh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] that lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm speechless. I would never in a million, billion years have suspected the Lt. Col. capable of something like this. It would appear that working for him was much less of an honor than I once thought.|Edbr Yamagh speaking of Wilfred Quelsh|<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Edbr Yamagh worked as an aide to retired [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lt. Col.]] [[Wilfred Quelsh]] in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Quelsh's [[Corellian Medal of Honor]] was stolen and Yamagh helped with the search. When Quelsh asked an independent agent to help in the investigation of the theft, Yamagh pointed the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to a group of local thugs known as [[Braggan's Fist]]. The agent managed to successfully solve the case of the stolen medal and found proof that Quelsh had framed former CorSec officer [[Kal Braggan]] for a crime that Quelsh had committed and that he had later murdered Braggan. Yamagh was left speechless by Quelsh's crimes, as he had always considered it an honor to work for a highly decorated officer like Quelsh.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Edbr Yamagh was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Edbr Yamagh was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> He could be found in the city of Tyrena on Corellia. Yamagh was part of the quest "[[:w:c:swg:CorSec Case Files: Stolen Honor|CorSec Case Files: Stolen Honor]]" which was part of the [[:w:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy quest line]], the longest quest line in the game.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />
